1.name: Lamplight
1.why: The warm light a patient hand leaves burning while something old is made new.

1.name: Sunlit Stone
1.why: Old stone in late sun, warm and unhurried, the color of a thing that has been kept well.

1.name: Vani Hoard
1.why: The granulated gold found at Vani, kept safe in the earth, and the first thing I picture when I think of home.

2.name: Willow Leaf
2.why: A young willow leaf in spring, going from dull to bright under a patient hand.

2.name: Meadow Grass
2.why: Meadow grass after rain, where the herbs I gather grow before the moon finds them.

2.name: Moonwort
2.why: The herb I gather by moonlight, and the freshness a dry branch takes on as I stir it.
